versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יוּשַׁ֥ר הַשִּׁיר־הַזֶּ֖ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה עִ֣יר עָז־לָ֔נוּ יְשׁוּעָ֥ה יָשִׁ֖ית חוֹמ֥וֹת וָחֵֽל׃

controles.web: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah:  “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
controles.kjv: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
controles.livre: Naquele dia, se cantará este cântico na terra de Judá: Temos uma cidade forte! Deus lhe pôs a salvação por muros e antemuros.

versos.hebraico: פִּתְח֖וּ שְׁעָרִ֑ים וְיָבֹ֥א גוֹי־צַדִּ֖יק שֹׁמֵ֥ר אֱמֻנִֽים׃

controles.web: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
controles.kjv: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
controles.livre: Abri as portas, para que por elas entre a nação justa, que guarda fidelidades.

versos.hebraico: יֵ֣צֶר סָמ֔וּךְ תִּצֹּ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם׀ שָׁל֑וֹם כִּ֥י בְךָ֖ בָּטֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
controles.kjv: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
controles.livre: Tu guardarás em completa paz aquele que tem firme entendimento, pois ele confia em ti.

versos.hebraico: בִּטְח֥וּ בַֽיהוָ֖ה עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד כִּ֚י בְּיָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה צ֖וּר עוֹלָמִֽים׃

controles.web: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
controles.kjv: Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength:
controles.livre: Confiai no SENHOR para sempre, pois no SENHOR DEUS está a rocha eterna.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י הֵשַׁח֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מָר֔וֹם קִרְיָ֖ה נִשְׂגָּבָ֑ה יַשְׁפִּילֶ֤נָּה יַשְׁפִּילָהּ֙ עַד־אֶ֔רֶץ יַגִּיעֶ֖נָּה עַד־עָפָֽר׃

controles.web: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
controles.kjv: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
controles.livre: Pois ele abate aos que habitam em lugares altos, a cidade elevada; certamente ele a abaixará até o chão, e a derrubará até o pó.

versos.hebraico: תִּרְמְסֶ֖נָּה רָ֑גֶל רַגְלֵ֥י עָנִ֖י פַּעֲמֵ֥י דַלִּֽים׃

controles.web: The foot shall tread it down; Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.”
controles.kjv: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
controles.livre: Pés a pisotearão; os pés dos afligidos, os passos dos pobres.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֥רַח לַצַּדִּ֖יק מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים יָשָׁ֕ר מַעְגַּ֥ל צַדִּ֖יק תְּפַלֵּֽס׃

controles.web: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
controles.kjv: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
controles.livre: O caminho do justo é todo plano; tu que és reto nivelas o andar do justo.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ף אֹ֧רַח מִשְׁפָּטֶ֛יךָ יְהוָ֖ה קִוִּינ֑וּךָ לְשִׁמְךָ֥ וּֽלְזִכְרְךָ֖ תַּאֲוַת־נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, have we waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
controles.kjv: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Lord, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
controles.livre: Também no caminho dos teus juízos esperamos em ti; em teu nome e em tua lembrança está o desejo de nossa alma.

versos.hebraico: נַפְשִׁ֤י אִוִּיתִ֨יךָ֙ בַּלַּ֔יְלָה אַף־רוּחִ֥י בְקִרְבִּ֖י אֲשַֽׁחֲרֶ֑ךָּ כִּ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מִשְׁפָּטֶ֨יךָ֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ צֶ֥דֶק לָמְד֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃

controles.web: With my soul have I desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
controles.kjv: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
controles.livre: Com minha alma te desejei de noite, e com meu espírito dentro de mim te busquei de madrugada; pois quando teus juízos estão sobre a terra, os moradores do mundo aprendem a justiça.

versos.hebraico: יֻחַ֤ן רָשָׁע֙ בַּל־לָמַ֣ד צֶ֔דֶק בְּאֶ֥רֶץ נְכֹח֖וֹת יְעַוֵּ֑ל וּבַל־יִרְאֶ֖ה גֵּא֥וּת יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.
controles.kjv: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.
controles.livre: Ainda que se faça favor ao perverso, nem assim ele aprende a justiça; até na terra dos corretos ele pratica maldade, e não dá atenção à majestade do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֛ה רָ֥מָה יָדְךָ֖ בַּל־יֶחֱזָי֑וּן יֶחֱז֤וּ וְיֵבֹ֨שׁוּ֙ קִנְאַת־עָ֔ם אַף־אֵ֖שׁ צָרֶ֥יךָ תֹאכְלֵֽם׃ס

controles.web: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
controles.kjv: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
controles.livre: Ó SENHOR, tua mão está levantada, mas eles não a veem; porém eles verão e serão envergonhados pelo zelo que tens do teu povo; e o fogo consumirá a teus adversários.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֕ה תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ת שָׁל֖וֹם לָ֑נוּ כִּ֛י גַּ֥ם כָּֽל־מַעֲשֵׂ֖ינוּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also worked all our works for us.
controles.kjv: Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
controles.livre: Ó SENHOR, tu nos fornecerá paz; pois todos os nossos feitos tu fizeste por nós.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּעָל֥וּנוּ אֲדֹנִ֖ים זֽוּלָתֶ֑ךָ לְבַד־בְּךָ֖ נַזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.
controles.kjv: O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
controles.livre: Ó SENHOR nosso Deus, outros senhores fora de ti nos dominaram; mas somente em ti, em teu nome, mantínhamos nossos pensamentos.

versos.hebraico: מֵתִים֙ בַּל־יִחְי֔וּ רְפָאִ֖ים בַּל־יָקֻ֑מוּ לָכֵ֤ן פָּקַ֨דְתָּ֙ וַתַּשְׁמִידֵ֔ם וַתְּאַבֵּ֥ד כָּל־זֵ֖כֶר לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
controles.kjv: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
controles.livre: Eles estão mortos, não voltarão a viver; fantasmas não ressuscitarão; por isso tu os visitaste e os destruíste, e eliminaste toda a memória deles.

versos.hebraico: יָסַ֤פְתָּ לַגּוֹי֙ יְהוָ֔ה יָסַ֥פְתָּ לַגּ֖וֹי נִכְבָּ֑דְתָּ רִחַ֖קְתָּ כָּל־קַצְוֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
controles.kjv: Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
controles.livre: Tu, SENHOR, engrandeceste esta nação; engrandeceste esta nação, e te fizeste glorioso; alargaste os limites da terra.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֖ה בַּצַּ֣ר פְּקָד֑וּךָ צָק֣וּן לַ֔חַשׁ מוּסָרְךָ֖ לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
controles.kjv: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
controles.livre: Ó SENHOR, na aflição eles te buscaram; quando tu os castigaste, uma oração eles sussurraram.

versos.hebraico: כְּמ֤וֹ הָרָה֙ תַּקְרִ֣יב לָלֶ֔דֶת תָּחִ֥יל תִּזְעַ֖ק בַּחֲבָלֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֛ן הָיִ֥ינוּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Like as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs; so we have been before you, Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O Lord.
controles.livre: Tal como a grávida quando chega a hora do parto, sofre e dá gritos por suas dores, assim fomos nós diante de tua presença, SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: הָרִ֣ינוּ חַ֔לְנוּ כְּמ֖וֹ יָלַ֣דְנוּ ר֑וּחַ יְשׁוּעֹת֙ בַּל־נַ֣עֲשֶׂה אֶ֔רֶץ וּבַֽל־יִפְּל֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃

controles.web: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
controles.kjv: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
controles.livre: Concebemos e tivemos dores, porém geramos nada além de vento. Não trouxemos libertação à terra, nem os moradores do mundo caíram.

versos.hebraico: יִֽחְי֣וּ מֵתֶ֔יךָ נְבֵלָתִ֖י יְקוּמ֑וּן הָקִ֨יצוּ וְרַנְּנ֜וּ שֹׁכְנֵ֣י עָפָ֗ר כִּ֣י טַ֤ל אוֹרֹת֙ טַלֶּ֔ךָ וָאָ֖רֶץ רְפָאִ֥ים תַּפִּֽיל׃ס

controles.web: Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
controles.kjv: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
controles.livre: Os teus mortos viverão, junto com meu cadáver, assim ressuscitarão; festejai e sede alegres, vós que habitais no pó! Pois o teu orvalho é orvalho de luz, e a terra gerará de si seus mortos.

versos.hebraico: לֵ֤ךְ עַמִּי֙ בֹּ֣א בַחֲדָרֶ֔יךָ וּֽסְגֹ֥ר דלתיך בַּעֲדֶ֑ךָ חֲבִ֥י כִמְעַט־רֶ֖גַע עַד־יעבור־זָֽעַם׃

controles.web: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
controles.kjv: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
controles.livre: Vai, ó povo meu; entra em teus quartos, e fecha tuas portas ao redor de ti; esconde-te por um momento, até que a ira tenha passado.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יֹצֵ֣א מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ לִפְקֹ֛ד עֲוֺ֥ן יֹֽשֵׁב־הָאָ֖רֶץ עָלָ֑יו וְגִלְּתָ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶת־דָּמֶ֔יהָ וְלֹֽא־תְכַסֶּ֥ה ע֖וֹד עַל־הֲרוּגֶֽיהָ׃ס

controles.web: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
controles.kjv: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
controles.livre: Porque eis que o SENHOR sairá de seu lugar para punir a maldade dos moradores da terra sobre eles; e a terra mostrará seus sangues, e não mais cobrirá seus mortos.
